citations.claim: At first violating step 15 pole has fallen to 0.823 rad and energy has blown up to ~37.7 J
Five steps earlier energy already growing rapidly (~10.8 J), showing divergent oscillation

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.0188 to 0, keeping all else identical; controller then stabilizes and no rule is violated.

explanation: Seeded sensor noise (~0.019) with large outer dt (~0.0183) destabilizes the fixed state-feedback controller: noisy angle/rate feedback causes growing over-correction, controller saturates at force_limit (50.75 at step 15), cart velocity reaches -8.0 m/s and pole rate 7.8 rad/s, pole angle diverges from -0.0067 to 0.82 rad in 15 steps, violating pole_upright.
vision_note: The cart drifts left while the pole leans increasingly to the right across steps 12 to 14. At step 15 the pole tip turns red as the lean grows past the upright limit.
